sections.content: Hungarian's word for 'the' is a before a consonant and az before a vowel: a konyha (the kitchen), but az ajtó (the door) and az ablak (the window).
sections.title: a or az

sections.content: az does double duty: it's 'that' (Az egy ablak — That's a window) and it's also 'the' before a vowel-initial noun (az ajtó — the door). Context makes clear which job it's doing.
